name: Kidcore
summary: The aesthetic is heavily influenced by Japanese street fashion styles like Decora , but is generally less elaborate and places a greater emphasis on comfort and accessibility.
description: The aesthetic is heavily influenced by Japanese street fashion styles like Decora , but is generally less elaborate and places a greater emphasis on comfort and accessibility. It is also related to the parallel Chinese trend of Dopamine Dressing . [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Nostalgia, childhood innocence, playfulness, reclaiming childhood, comfort

visualDNA.colour: Bright primary colors, rainbow palettes, neon accents
